_doc: Pack-and-escort variant of hunt-policy.json for the tier-2 hulls (route hunt-network-packs): the solo lane and the XP fallback are off, so a hull that burns five to fifteen times a starter's fuel fights only in a pack (whales and tougher game within rule F9 for the pack) or escorts, and otherwise rests where it docked (no fuel). Same claims and packs files as hunt-network.
_tune: Apophis 2026-11-24 15:38 UTC: the four Recursions flew 46 hunts in 6 hours on starter prey, 2.63 kills a run, -127,062 cr, -7,950 cr a ship-hour (runs.jsonl 09:36 to 15:36 UTC); a starter's T0 hunts read -918 cr a ship-hour. Packs and escorts as hunt-network's first flight.
_stopgap: Apophis 2026-11-24 15:48 UTC: exclude_systems holds the 18 systems whose nearest dock is our outpost GSC-0044 (no storage, its fuel bunker a supply chain, requests ENT-513) until the hunt_net fix that drops outposts from the docks is installed; then emptied.
